bio: Keith Crosland and Dustin Moss are Edmonton-based Partner and Mortgage Brokers at Mortgage Connection, a Calgary/Edmonton brokerage that cites over 1,700 five-star reviews. Keith is an Edmonton native in banking since 2008 (ten years as a mortgage specialist); Dustin worked over 14 years at a Big 5 bank, the last seven in mortgages. They also run keithanddustinmortgages.ca, covering purchase, renewal, debt consolidation and refinance. Mortgage Connection donates a portion of funded mortgages to community causes.
tagline: Trusted Mortgage Brokers in Calgary & Edmonton. Culture. Collaboration. Community.
